segments.summary: left-aligned 2-line headline builds word by word (rise 18 px + fade, 4.2 f stagger) beside a cluster of six agent logo icons on hexagon cells over a masked hex-outline grid; small black dots hop between icon centres (24 f ease-in-out), the icons pulse to 1.05-1.06 in turn every 25.2 f; the whole layer zooms 3% and fades out

chat window (left) and dark terminal window (right) under a centred 1-line headline: a prompt is typed into the chat input, the send button presses, the message bubble rises in, the list steps up for a status line, the terminal prints its work line by line in one-frame steps, the status flips and a reply rises in after a one-frame list jump; the headline fades and the terminal slides out right through a fade

same two-window layout with a second agent's terminal (slid in from the left during T02) and a 2-word headline: a shorter prompt is typed slower, sent with the same press, bubble, status and step-scroll devices; the terminal prints a review in one-frame steps and the reply rises in; both windows then shrink and fade

hub diagram (white centre card, six dark agent tiles, dashed connectors, 1-word label, centred headline) zoom-settles in from 1.11; dark packets fly out to the tiles every 6 f (23 f each), each landing prints a command line, then results return as grey or dark packets every 16-17 f and step a reply counter; from f922 to f944 it holds completely still, then the headline fades out in place (f945-f956) as the pull-back morph begins

two-team network at canvas scale 0.553 (two white hubs with 1-word labels, 12 dark icon tiles, dashed connectors) under a new 1-line headline; the first packet hop already crosses the top row in T04 (f990-f1021); camera settles f1015, then packet dots hop node to node and connectors darken with traffic; headline fades out from f1114

4x3 grid of 12 teams (12 hubs, 72 tiles) at canvas scale 0.284 of S04 behind a centred 1-line headline; packets hop again from f1160 during the zoom, camera at rest from f1188, dense packet traffic (11-29 dots); at f1294 every dot and long connector is cut in one frame, from f1295 each card shrinks and fades while a hexagon grows in its place, labels, spokes and headline fade
84 dark hexagons only: short hold, outward-staggered swarm into a honeycomb disc at the frame centre, ring-by-ring collapse into one growing cell that holds from f1445

end card: brand mark (hexagon) arrives by a jump cut with closed eye bars that open, slides left while the 1-word wordmark's letters fade in and rise 17 px one after another, 1-line grey tagline rises in below, static hold to the last frame
